notes.title: Grok Bot：官方用法目录增收 36 个角色
notes.body: 来源 https://x.ai/bot/use-cases （及扩容帖退款追回经理）：公寓侦察、差旅协调、日历协调、招聘筛选、入职经理、客户研究、会前准备、销售通话教练、交易台、续约台、幻灯片现场更新、Beta 采用、通话 FAQ、文档审计、需求溯源、产品反馈、玩法测试、原型构建、云端 Agent 编排、安全问卷、供应商门户、合同台、退款追回、SEO/AEO、社媒、付费素材策略、LinkedIn 投放、营销日历、周边履约、社区运营、关键事件监测、活动嘉宾筛选、赋能交付、工单分拣、演示文稿设计、对内传播。已有 29 条对应角色未重复收录。@bot 时间线本次未能读取。
notes.titleEn: Grok Bot: +36 roles from the official use-cases catalog
notes.bodyEn: From https://x.ai/bot/use-cases (plus Refunds manager on the expansion post): apartment scout, travel and calendar coordinators, hiring screener, onboarding, account research, meeting prep, sales call coach, deal desk, renewal desk, live deck updater, beta adoption, call FAQ miner, docs auditor, feature-request tracker, product feedback, playtest, prototype builder, cloud-agent orchestrator, security questionnaire, vendor portal, contract desk, refunds claims, SEO/AEO, social, paid-creative strategy, LinkedIn campaigns, marketing calendar, merch fulfillment, community ops, compelling-events monitor, event guest screener, enablement fulfillment, ticket triage, presentation designer, internal comms. The existing 29 matching roles were not duplicated. @bot timeline was not readable this run.

notes.bodyEn: Community case: @KanekoaTheGreat used Grok Bot to transcribe 38 Seheult-related videos, select 13 segments into a 19:35 cut, and generate timestamped Markdown. The card uses a tweet screenshot as the preview.

notes.title: 补全预览缩略图
notes.body: HTML 收集与 Agent UI 的 masonry 卡片改为自托管预览缩略图（public/previews），Pinterest 墙显示真实界面/效果，而不是纯色海报。图片路径走 Astro base，适配 GitHub Pages。缺图或加载失败时仍回退库海报。同时把 ThreeUI 原文改成现用的 /{category}/{slug} Community 路由。
notes.titleEn: Fill in preview thumbnails
notes.bodyEn: HTML Collection and Agent UI masonry cards now use self-hosted preview thumbnails (public/previews). The Pinterest wall shows real UI/effects instead of flat-color posters. Image paths go through the Astro base for GitHub Pages. Missing or failed images still fall back to the library poster. ThreeUI source links now use the current /{category}/{slug} Community routes.

notes.title: 界面：三张海报 + Pinterest 式浏览墙
notes.body: 首页改为三张库海报（Grok Bot / HTML 收集 / Agent UI）加跨库精选瀑布流。Grok Bot 总览移到 /cases/。各库与精选/最新/类型页改为视觉优先的 masonry 卡片：有 previewImage 用图，否则用库海报，不再用时间线当主界面。
notes.titleEn: UI: three posters + a Pinterest-style wall
notes.bodyEn: Home is now three library posters (Grok Bot / HTML Collection / Agent UI) plus a cross-library featured masonry. Grok Bot overview moved to /cases/. Each library and featured/latest/types page is now visual-first masonry: previewImage when present, otherwise the library poster. The timeline is no longer the main UI.

notes.title: 界面：字号、密度与表面打磨
notes.body: 全站改用 Geist + Noto Sans SC（中文一等），收紧标题字重与字距；卡片、顶栏分段开关、库选择、时间线与搜索更密一档，边框与阴影更克制。三库配色（琥珀 / 青绿 / 靛紫）与案例、HTML、Agent UI 数据不变。
notes.titleEn: UI: type size, density, and surface polish
notes.bodyEn: The site now uses Geist + Noto Sans SC (Chinese first), with tighter title weight and tracking. Cards, header segmented controls, library picker, timeline, and search are one step denser; borders and shadows are quieter. The three library colors (amber / teal / violet) and the Grok, HTML, and Agent UI data are unchanged.

notes.title: 站点更名为 AI UP LAB，并新增 Agent UI 库
notes.body: 对外品牌定为 AI UP LAB：可复用的 AI 精选实验室 · 案例 / 页面 / Agent UI。顶栏现为三库：Grok Bot（琥珀）、HTML 收集（青绿）、Agent UI（靛紫）。Agent UI 首批收录 ThreeUI Community 免费组件（MIT，免登录），可复制 prompt / Skill.md 换主题；不含 Pro，也不提供 MCP。Grok Bot 与 HTML 数据、路由保持不变。
notes.titleEn: Site renamed AI UP LAB, Agent UI library added
notes.bodyEn: Public brand is AI UP LAB: a reusable AI collection lab · cases / pages / Agent UI. The header now has three libraries: Grok Bot (amber), HTML Collection (teal), Agent UI (violet). Agent UI’s first batch is free ThreeUI Community components (MIT, no login); copy a prompt / Skill.md to retheme. No Pro, no MCP. Grok Bot and HTML data and routes stay the same.

notes.title: 界面：近日更新时间线与收录理由
notes.body: 双库首页增加按 updatedAt 分组的「今日收录 / 近日更新」，卡片展示收录理由（qualityNote），并加上当前库搜索、上手路径与 /search 两库检索。不是行业新闻站。
notes.titleEn: UI: recent-update timeline and why we listed it
notes.bodyEn: The dual-library home gained “listed today / recent updates” grouped by updatedAt. Cards show why we listed it (qualityNote), plus in-library search, a start path, and /search across both libraries. Not an industry news site.
